title: #104 Lazy Journalism
prompt: The lazy journalism has become commonplace in today's digitalized world. How do you define 'lazy journalism'? What is the cause?

promptSegments.text: The lazy journalism has become commonplace in today's digitalized world.

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.
requirements.vi: Trả lời mọi câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

requirements.en: State a clear and consistent position when an opinion is requested.
requirements.vi: Nêu quan điểm rõ ràng và nhất quán khi đề yêu cầu ý kiến.

requirements.en: Develop each main idea with explanation and an example.
requirements.vi: Phát triển mỗi ý chính bằng giải thích và ví dụ.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that digitalization is the main cause of poor journalism and suggests education as a solution.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that digitalization is the main cause of poor journalism and suggests education as a solution.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay uses simple, direct language and avoids complex linking words, focusing on concrete examples and clear cause-and-effect relationships.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay uses simple, direct language and avoids complex linking words, focusing on concrete examples and clear cause-and-effect relationships.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The main cause of lazy journalism is the lack of control over publishing online.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main cause of lazy journalism is the lack of control over publishing online.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A practical solution is for media companies to improve their training and skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A practical solution is for media companies to improve their training and skills.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The primary cause of lazy journalism is the structural shift in media consumption driven by digital platforms, which favors speed and sensationalism over depth.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The primary cause of lazy journalism is the structural shift in media consumption driven by digital platforms, which favors speed and sensationalism over depth.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A practical solution involves strengthening professional education to equip future journalists with the ethical and technical skills necessary to maintain high standards of reporting.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A practical solution involves strengthening professional education to equip future journalists with the ethical and technical skills necessary to maintain high standards of reporting.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not ignore a direct question in the prompt.
promptTraps.vi: Không bỏ qua câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
